platform_constraints: Tauri v2 (@tauri-apps/api ^2.2.0) — use invoke() for Rust IPC, not window.__TAURI__
Video files: HTMLVideoElement blob URLs work in Tauri webview. CSP allows blob: media-src
Canvas 2D getImageData works for frame extraction. willReadFrequently:true for perf hint
requestVideoFrameCallback is preferred for frame-accurate capture (Chrome/Edge/Tauri WebView2)
Fallback: video.addEventListener('play', ...) + requestAnimationFrame loop for non-rVFC browsers
Android target requires @tauri-apps/cli ^2.2.0 with Android NDK. Media permissions in AndroidManifest
File read: use Tauri dialog plugin or HTML file input. No raw fs:// in webview
Rust side: image crate ^0.25 with rayon for parallel pixel processing

exact_code_recipes.how_to_wire: In App.tsx, when user selects video file: 1) Create hidden <video> element with blob URL src, 2) Call createVideoToAsciiPipeline(video, offscreenCanvas, (imageData) => renderImageDataToAscii(imageData, options), {targetWidth: cols, targetHeight: rows}), 3) OnFrame callback feeds into existing renderImageDataToAscii(), 4) Stop pipeline on tab switch or unmount. Critical: add video.play() after oncanplay fires.

Replace existing handleSelectImageFile in App.tsx. The current implementation calls preflightImageSource which downsamples to 2048x2048 — keep that for preflight, but ensure the final canvas draw uses targetWidth=targetColumns, targetHeight=targetRows. The existing rasterizeImageData callback already consumes ImageData correctly.

exact_code_recipes.feature: Monochrome Loading Animation (CSS Keyframes, Zero Dependencies)
exact_code_recipes.how_to_wire: Import in App.tsx. Show AsciiLoader when isInitialLoad=true (first 2-3 seconds) OR when video/image is processing. Wrap in AnimatePresence for exit fade. Replace the current 400ms setTimeout with actual processing state tracking.

exact_code_recipes.feature: Monochrome Dark UI Token System (Zero AI-Slop, Pure B&W)
exact_code_recipes.how_to_wire: Replace all hardcoded colors in components. Remove #3b82f6 accent from non-interactive elements. All borders use --border. All text uses --text-primary/secondary/muted scale. Buttons use --surface-elevated background with --border border, hover to --surface-hover. Primary actions only get --accent.

exact_code_recipes.feature: Video Playback Wiring (ensure video actually plays in Tauri webview)
exact_code_recipes.how_to_wire: The current handleSelectVideoFile in App.tsx only sets activeTab='video' and shows a warning message but never creates a video element or starts playback. This is why video input produces no output. Fix: create hidden video element, call ensureVideoPlaying(), then feed into createVideoToAsciiPipeline.

anti_hallucination_guidance: BANNED: Do not use requestAnimationFrame alone for video frame capture — it fires when the page is composited, NOT when a new video frame is decoded. Use requestVideoFrameCallback when available.
BANNED: Do not assume canvas.toDataURL() will work for video frames without first calling drawImage(). The canvas is empty until explicitly drawn.
BANNED: Do not use video.currentTime = X for frame seeking in a streaming pipeline — this causes decode stalls. Use the natural playback + rVFC approach.
BANNED: Do not add colorful gradients, neon effects, or rainbow accents. User demands pure monochrome #000000/#ffffff/#121212.
BANNED: Do not use framer-motion for the loading animation — keep it pure CSS keyframes for zero-dependency simplicity.
BANNED: Do not write ad-hoc CSS outside of Tailwind utility classes + CSS custom properties. All styling via tokens.
